reason: Automatic approval questioned whether synthetic financial and code fixtures were real private user data.

cases.json.note: Original regression cases. checks are review criteria, not proof of quality or automatic AI detection.

scenarios.json.note: Six original synthetic cross-scenario controls added after the user requested broader practical coverage; no model outputs existed at authoring.

clarifications.X001: Fictional half-year company statement authored in scenarios.json for this test, not a company filing.
clarifications.X005: A small cached_value example authored in scenarios.json, not production application code.

decision: Request normal approval again for the same command using this source evidence; do not change command, data, destination or permissions to bypass review.
